content:
Day One
Upon arrival in Tokyo thou shalt wander the neon streets of Shibuya
Thou shalt gaze upon the Hachiko statue and feel the pulse of the city
In the eve thou shalt dine upon sushi at a tiny izakaya
Thou shalt retire to a ryokan where tatami mats cradle thy rest

Day Two
Morning finds thee at the Meiji Shrine amidst towering cedars
Thou shalt offer a prayer and listen to the whisper of wind
Afterward thou shalt stroll through Harajuku where fashion doth bloom like cherry blossoms
Evening thou shalt ascend the Tokyo Tower and behold the city lights like a thousand fireflies

Day Three
Thou shalt take the shinkansen to Kyoto swift as a swallow
Upon arrival thou shalt visit the Kinkakuji Golden Pavilion shimmering upon the pond
Thou shalt walk the Philosopher's Path where stones doth speak of ancient sages
Night thou shalt partake in a tea ceremony and feel the calm of matcha

Day Four
Morning thou shalt explore the Fushimi Inari shrine with its thousand vermilion gates
Thou shalt climb the mountain and let the fox spirits guide thy steps
Afternoon thou shalt wander the Gion district where geisha glide like shadows
Evening thou shalt feast upon kaiseki cuisine a symphony of flavors

Day Five
Thou shalt journey to Nara where deer bow in reverence
Thou shalt feed the gentle creatures and visit the Todaiji temple housing the great Buddha
Afterwards thou shalt return to Kyoto and rest thy weary limbs

Day Six
Thou shalt set forth to Osaka the kitchen of the nation
Thou shalt sample takoyaki and okonomiyaki amidst the bustling Dotonbori canal
Night thou shalt ride the Ferris wheel and watch the river dance with neon

Day Seven
Thou shalt return to Tokyo for thy final hours
Thou shalt visit the Meiji Mori Garden and contemplate the fleeting beauty of sakura
Thou shalt purchase souvenirs and carry home memories like precious jewels
Thus ends thy journey in the land of the rising sun
